ctx.x: You're calling the Albert for the players who played Albert.
You say that the young Lorenzo Teo used Albert too.

Albert's system. And just here lately after the fellow just found out, let me see, I believe I was the only fellow I believe around here was using the Bernborn System home. Because as many times I used to catch a lot of them guys, you know, because we used to go in dances, at the time we used to give dances at that time, economy hall, corporators and stuff.
